name: Naaman
overview: The Scriptures present Naaman as a notable figure both genealogically and historically. He is named among the sons of Benjamin and Bela, linking him to Israelite ancestry (Genesis 46:21; Numbers 26:40). More prominently, Naaman is depicted as a valiant Syrian general who was afflicted with leprosy, yet through the faith and testimony of a captive Israelite maid and the prophet Elisha, he received miraculous healing (2 Kings 5:1-4). This account highlights God's sovereign power to heal and deliver, extending His mercy beyond Israel to a foreign commander, underscoring the gospel truth that God's grace is accessible to all who trust in Him.
